title: Common Errors
markdown:
| Message or symptom | Usual cause | Fix | Lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| Errors about `min` or `max` in standard headers | `windows.h` defines `min` and `max` macros | `#define NOMINMAX` before including it | 1.01 |
| Text shows as `?` or boxes | The A functions with a legacy code page, or UTF-8 passed where UTF-16 is expected | Call the W functions; convert at the boundary | 1.02 |
| The window cannot be moved, resized or closed | Unhandled messages not passed to `DefWindowProcW` | Return `DefWindowProcW(...)` for everything you do not handle | 1.03 |
| The program keeps running after the window closes | No `PostQuitMessage` in `WM_DESTROY` | Call `PostQuitMessage(0)` | 1.03 |
| One CPU core at 100 % | `WM_PAINT` without `BeginPaint`/`EndPaint`, so the area never becomes valid | Always pair them | 1.05 |
| Drawing stops after a while | GDI objects leaked (deleted while selected, or never deleted) | Select the old object back, then `DeleteObject`; watch "GDI objects" in Task Manager | 1.05 |
| Mouse positions jump to about 65 000 | `LOWORD` used for coordinates on multi-monitor setups | `GET_X_LPARAM` / `GET_Y_LPARAM` | 1.04 |
| Typed text has the wrong letters on some keyboards | Text built from `WM_KEYDOWN` | Use `WM_CHAR` (and keep `TranslateMessage` in the loop) | 2.01 |
| Alt+F4 stops working | `WM_SYSKEYDOWN` swallowed | Pass system keys you do not use to `DefWindowProcW` | 2.01 |
| A drag gets stuck "pressed" | Capture lost without a button-up | Handle `WM_CAPTURECHANGED` | 2.02 |
| A countdown runs slow | Counting `WM_TIMER` ticks | Compute from the real clock | 2.03 |
| Ctrl+S does nothing although the menu shows it | No accelerator table, or `TranslateAcceleratorW` missing from the loop | Load the table and translate before dispatching | 2.04 |
| Controls look like Windows 95 | No common controls v6 manifest entry | Add the dependency (lesson 3.05) | 3.05 |
| Controls use a bold old font | Controls not given a font | `WM_SETFONT` with the message font | 2.05 |
| Tab does nothing | No `IsDialogMessageW` in the loop | Add it, and `WS_TABSTOP` on controls | 2.05 |
| The program is blurry on a laptop | Not DPI aware | Per-monitor v2 in the manifest; scale sizes | 3.04 |
| Everything is tiny at 150 % | DPI aware but sizes not scaled | `MulDiv(value, dpi, 96)` everywhere | 3.04 |
| Flicker when resizing | Background erased before painting | Return 1 from `WM_ERASEBKGND`; double buffer; `WS_CLIPCHILDREN` | 4.01 |
| The window goes blank after a driver update | Direct2D device loss ignored | Re-create device resources on `D2DERR_RECREATE_TARGET` | 4.02 |
| Edges of transparent images have dark fringes | Straight alpha filtered as premultiplied | Convert to 32bppPBGRA | 4.04 |
| "The process cannot access the file because it is being used by another process" (32) | Share mode conflict | Use suitable share modes; retry briefly | 5.01 |
| A recursive search never ends | `.`, `..` or links followed | Skip them and reparse points | 5.01 |
| A registry string is cut in half | Size passed in characters instead of bytes | `(length + 1) * sizeof(wchar_t)` | 5.02 |
| Access denied writing settings | Writing to HKLM or Program Files | Use HKCU and AppData | 5.02 |
| `CreateProcessW` crashes | A string literal passed as the command line | Pass a writable buffer | 5.03 |
| Arguments with spaces break | Missing or wrong quoting | Quote with the backslash rules | 5.03 |
| Reading a child's output hangs | Our copy of the pipe's write end still open | Close it after `CreateProcessW` | 5.03 |
| The window freezes ("Not responding") | Long work or waiting on the UI thread | Move it to a worker thread | 5.04 |
| Random crashes with threads | Data shared without a lock, or a worker touching windows | Lock shared data; post messages to the UI thread | 5.04 |
| A deadlock between two threads | `SendMessageW` to a waiting thread, or locks taken in different orders | `PostMessageW`; one lock order | 5.04 |
| Pasted text has odd line breaks | Line endings not normalised | Convert `\r\n`, `\r` and `\n` | 5.05 |
| SmartScreen warns about the program | The .exe is not signed | Code-sign with a timestamp | 6.02 |
